$schema_note: Machine-readable project state for LLM hand-off. Not meant for human reading — see docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md (architecture/flow prose), docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md (agent-facing, non-technical), docs/TOUCHPOINT_LAYOUT.md (Zoho page-layout field reference) for that. This file must be updated in the same change as any code edit that touches routing, appState shape, a form's fields/payload, ReasonBranchFields' branch keys, select-options.js exports, or the handoff mechanism — same standing rule as the other two docs (see memory: keep-developer-guide-in-sync, keep-agent-guide-in-sync).

project.name: Touchpoint Widget
project.purpose: Zoho CRM widget (Vue 3 + Vite, packaged with zet) opened from a Maintenance Offer record. Sales agent logs a call by picking a conversation type + outcome, then fills a type-specific form. Submitting creates a Maintenance_Touchpoints record (one form also updates Maintenance_Request records). No dashboard/report scope beyond that.

stack.framework: Vue 3, <script setup> SFCs only, no router, no state library (plain ref()s)
stack.build: vite build && zet pack (npm run build) -> app/ then dist/touchpoint_widget.zip (the Zoho upload artifact)
stack.local_dev_limitation: npm run dev renders UI but ZOHO.CRM.* calls throw/no-op outside the real Zoho iframe — no local mock exists. All functional testing is manual, inside Zoho, after a real build+upload.
stack.lint_format: ESLint + Prettier configured; project convention is editor-formats-on-save, so format/format:check is NOT run after every edit (see memory: skip-prettier-check-after-edits). npm run lint is still used to catch no-undef/no-unused-vars. Baseline expected lint noise: 'ZOHO' is not defined (no-undef) on every file calling ZOHO.CRM.* — not a regression.

file_manifest.src/main.js: ZOHO.embeddedApp bootstrap. Reads EntityId from PageLoad event into appState.entityId, calls ZOHO.CRM.UI.Resize({width:1200,height:750}), mounts App with @formkit/auto-animate plugin.
file_manifest.src/App.vue: Router substitute: one v-if per appState.page value, wraps forms in <div v-auto-animate>. Six branches: home, intro, post-service-feedback, active-client-feedback, re-engagement, churned-feedback.
file_manifest.src/store.js: appState ref — the ONLY cross-form shared state: conversationType, callOutcome, entityId, page. Everything else is a local ref in the owning form. Do not add form-specific fields here.
file_manifest.src/store/handoff.js: One-shot module-level ref bridge: setHandoffData(data)/consumeHandoffData() (read-and-clear). Used solely for ReEngagementForm -> ChurnedFeedbackForm.
file_manifest.src/store/user.js: useUserStore() composable: user ref + fetchUser() -> ZOHO.CRM.CONFIG.getCurrentUser(), sets user.value = responseData.users[0]. Called by every form except ActiveClientFeedbackForm.
file_manifest.src/store/maintenanceOffer.js: useMaintenanceOfferStore() composable (added 2026-08-21): maintenanceOffer ref + fetchMaintenanceOffer() -> ZOHO.CRM.API.getRecord({Entity:'Maintenance_Sales', RecordID: appState.entityId}), sets maintenanceOffer.value = response.data[0]. Called only by HomeForm, to read Lifecycle_Status for availableConversationTypes filtering. Entity name is hardcoded, not read from the PageLoad event, since this widget is always opened from a Maintenance_Sales record.
file_manifest.src/config/select-options.js: All dropdown/multiselect option arrays, grouped into commented sections by consumer (Home / Shared-across-forms / Intro / Post-Service Feedback / Active Client Feedback / Shared reason-branch fields / Re-engagement / Churned). Source of truth for exact option values — this JSON does not duplicate them except where a value is a mapping key elsewhere in this file.
file_manifest.src/utils/touchpoint.js: createTouchpoint(apiData) -> ZOHO.CRM.API.insertRecord({Entity:'Maintenance_Touchpoints', APIData: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(apiData)), Trigger:['workflow']}). Used by every form. The JSON round-trip was added 2026-08-21 — see known_bugs_fixed_this_project.reactive-proxy-clone-failure.
file_manifest.src/utils/maintenanceRequests.js: updateMaintenanceRequests(recordIds, fields) -> recordIds.map(id => ZOHO.CRM.API.updateRecord({Entity:'Maintenance_Request' (singular, intentional — real Zoho API name), APIData:{id,...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fields))}, Trigger:['workflow']})) — returns an ARRAY of promises, one per record (not a single bulk call). Used only by PostServiceFeedbackForm. Same JSON round-trip added 2026-08-21 as defensive insurance, though no current field passed here is reactive.
file_manifest.src/components/Base*.vue: BaseSelect, BaseMultiSelect, BaseInput, BaseTextarea, BaseButton — generic form controls.
file_manifest.src/components/TablePagination.vue: Used only by PostServiceFeedbackForm's request table.
file_manifest.src/components/Clock.vue: Unused scaffold leftover. Not imported anywhere. Safe to delete.
file_manifest.src/components/forms/HomeForm.vue: Entry screen. Filters the Conversation option dropdown by the current Maintenance_Sales.Lifecycle_Status — see forms.HomeForm below.
file_manifest.src/components/forms/PostServiceFeedback: Writes to two modules; has known bugs (see known_bugs).
file_manifest.src/components/forms/ActiveClientFeedbac: Mounts ReasonBranchFields for its concern tree.
file_manifest.src/components/forms/ReEngagementForm.vu: Mounts ReasonBranchFields; can hand off to Churned instead of submitting.
file_manifest.src/components/forms/ChurnedFeedbackForm: Mounts ReasonBranchFields; can be entered directly or via Re-engagement handoff.
Shared conditional-field tree mounted by the three forms above. See shared_component.reason_branch_fields below.

app_state_shape.entityId: string — Maintenance Offer record id from PageLoad EntityId
app_state_shape.page: string — one of: home | intro | post-service-feedback | active-client-feedback | re-engagement | churned-feedback

routing.mechanism: No router. App.vue does v-if on appState.page. Two writers of appState.page in the whole codebase.

writers.condition: isClosingReEngagement === 'Yes' AND reEngagementOutcome in {Lost To Competitor, Hard Refusal, Out Of Business}
side_effects: does NOT call createTouchpoint — skips Re-engagement's own touchpoint entirely

routing.invariant: If a 7th form/page is ever added, three places must use the exact same string literal: App.vue (v-if + import), HomeForm.vue's if/else-if chain, select-options.js's ConversationTypes. No shared constant exists for page names or conversation-type values — verified manually, not enforced structurally.

HomeForm.uses_maintenance_offer_store: added 2026-08-21 — fetchMaintenanceOffer() called fire-and-forget at setup, same pattern as fetchUser(). No .catch on it (minor robustness gap, see known_bugs).

fields.options: availableConversationTypes (computed — see below). Falls back to the full ConversationTypes list while maintenanceOffer hasn't loaded or its Lifecycle_Status isn't in the map.

computed.availableConversationTypes: ConversationTypes.filter(opt => (AllowedConversationTypesByLifecycleStatus[maintenanceOffer?.Lifecycle_Status] || ConversationTypes.map(o=>o.value)).includes(opt.value)) — added 2026-08-21. AllowedConversationTypesByLifecycleStatus is a DRAFT map in select-options.js, not yet product-confirmed except for two settled points: Intro is offered from Activated/Active (client may not know all services yet), and Re-engagement is offered from both Dormant AND Churned (spec allows a human to manually restart from Churned).

HomeForm.submit_logic: If isNotConnected: createTouchpoint({Maintenance_Offers, Conversation_Type, Call_Outcome, Next_Action_Date, Owner}) -> alert -> closeReload (terminal, no further form for ANY conversationType). Else: route appState.page per conversationType (see routing.writers[0]) — no CRM write happens here, the picked form writes its own touchpoint later.

IntroForm.submit_logic: Single createTouchpoint call with all fields above + Maintenance_Offers/Conversation_Type/Call_Outcome/Owner -> alert -> closeReload. No shared component, no branch tree. Payload guards mirror the v-if condition directly inline (no separate computed) — no drift possible.

fields.model: shopRatings — ref({}) keyed by request id, NOT an array, NOT a single shared value
fields.options: ratingOptions (string '1'-'5', NOT numbers — fixed 2026-08-21: Shop_Rating is a Zoho picklist field, so the API sends/returns these as strings; numeric option.value made pre-fill-from-existing-rating fail to match)
fields.required: conditionally — :required="selectedRequests.includes(request.id)", so only checked rows block submit if left unrated
fields.note: Changed 2026-08-21 from one shared truckShopRating field to per-row — a single call can cover requests serviced by different shops. Bare native <select>, not BaseSelect (BaseSelect's fixed-width label doesn't fit a table cell). Re-initialized inside fetchRequests() every time reqData changes (same reset point as selectedRequests being cleared on page/limit change), but pre-filled from request.Shop_Rating (String(...)-coerced) when the fetched request already has a rating, not blanked unconditionally — fixed same day, see known_bugs_fixed_this_project.

fields.model: agentRatings — ref({}) keyed by request id, same shape/treatment as shopRatings
fields.note: Changed 2026-08-21, same reasoning as shop-rating above — pre-filled from request.Maintenance_Agent_Rating.

data_source.response_shape: response.details.output is a JSON string; parsed to {data, info:{more_records}}
table_columns: Truck_Unit_Number / Trailer_Unit_Number joined as Unit Number
data_source.pagination: reqPage/reqLimit via TablePagination.vue + RequestLimitOptions (10/25/50). handleLimitChange/goToPrevPage/goToNextPage all clear selectedRequests before refetching; shopRatings/agentRatings get reset inside fetchRequests() itself once the new reqData arrives, not pre-cleared in those three functions.

submit_logic_ordered_steps: 1. touchpointApiData = {Maintenance_Offers, Conversation_Type, Call_Outcome, Next_Action_Date, Owner} — NOT the rating fields, which never touch the touchpoint record at all.
3. DEAD CODE: await ZOHO.CRM.API.getRecord({Entity:'Maintenance_Touchpoints', approved:'both', RecordID: createResp.data[0].details.id}) then console.log(tp) — result unused, see known_bugs

4. updatePromises = selectedRequests.flatMap(id => updateMaintenanceRequests([id], {Service_Satisfaction, Will_Use_Again, Shop_Rating: shopRatings[id], Maintenance_Agent_Rating: agentRatings[id], Touchpoint: {id: createResp.data[0].details.id}})) — changed 2026-08-21 from one shared updateFields object for all rows to a per-row object, since Shop_Rating/Maintenance_Agent_Rating now differ per request while Service_Satisfaction/Will_Use_Again/Touchpoint stay shared. Still N separate updateRecord calls, N = selectedRequests.length — updateMaintenanceRequests itself wasn't changed, just called once per id instead of once for the whole array.
PostServiceFeedbackForm.note: isLoading is set false only inside the final setTimeout, not in a .finally() — see known_bugs. A different implementation of this form once existed in an old Claude Code plan file (~/.claude/plans/post-service-feedback-form-prancy-hinton.md) — that plan describes a single bulk updateRecord call, Number() casts on ratings, encodeURIComponent on strings, and a Maintenance_Requests lookup field on the touchpoint itself. NONE of that matches current source — the plan is STALE/SUPERSEDED, do not treat it as current design intent.

computed.concernBranch: hasConcerns === 'Yes' ? (PRIMARY_CONCERN_TO_BRANCH[primaryConcern] || '') : ''  — FIXED BUG: must gate on hasConcerns, not just primaryConcern (see known_bugs_fixed)

ActiveClientFeedbackForm.submit_logic: apiData = {Maintenance_Offers, Conversation_Type, Call_Outcome, Next_Action_Date, Overall_Experience, Client_Likes, Main_Reason, What_Can_We_Improve, Has_Concerns, Primary_Concern (resolved via hasConcerns gate), Owner, ...branchFields} -> createTouchpoint -> alert -> closeReload. Owner added 2026-08-20 (this form used to be the one exception that didn't send it, see known_bugs_fixed_this_project.active-client-no-owner).

fields.note: gate for the entire outcome block below

A Next_Review_Date field (shown/required specifically for 'Not Now', replacing this field for that one outcome) was added and removed again on 2026-08-21 — product decided Next_Action_Date should stay consistent across every outcome and every form. blank_when_hidden still applies for the churn-bound outcomes via opensChurnedForm.

computed.resolvedOutcome: isClosingReEngagement === 'Yes' ? reEngagementOutcome : ''  — the correct guard pattern (contrast ActiveClientFeedback's fixed bug). A local const inside the submit function, not a top-level computed — briefly hoisted to a computed on 2026-08-21 so the template could also gate next-action-date's visibility on it, then reverted the same day along with that whole Next_Review_Date experiment (see next-action-date field note above).
computed.opensChurnedForm: !!CHURN_REASON_BY_OUTCOME[reEngagementOutcome.value]  — NOTE: reads raw reEngagementOutcome, not resolvedOutcome, but is only ever meaningful while isClosingReEngagement==='Yes' since that's the only time the outcome section (and this computed's effect) is visible

ReEngagementForm.submit_logic: resolvedOutcome computed. branchFields = ReasonBranchFields.getApiFields(). reEngagementFields assembled (see field list). Competitor_Name = branchFields.Competitor_Name || (resolvedOutcome==='Lost To Competitor' ? competitorName : '') — reason-branch value wins if present. Why_Competitor_Won = resolvedOutcome==='Lost To Competitor' ? whyCompetitorWon : (branchFields.Why_Competitor_Won || '') — outcome value wins if present. Contactability = resolvedOutcome==='Unable To Reach' ? 'Unreachable' : ''. churnReason = CHURN_REASON_BY_OUTCOME[resolvedOutcome]. IF churnReason truthy: setHandoffData({churnReason, competitorName: reEngagementFields.Competitor_Name, whyCompetitorWon: reEngagementFields.Why_Competitor_Won, reEngagementFields}); appState.conversationType='Churned Feedback'; appState.page='churned-feedback'; isLoading=false; RETURN — no createTouchpoint call at all. ELSE: createTouchpoint(reEngagementFields) -> alert -> closeReload.

fields.seeded_from_handoff: RETURN_POTENTIAL_TO_POSSIBILITY[incomingHandoff.reEngagementFields.Return_Potential] — added 2026-08-21 to reconcile Re-engagement's Return_Potential and Churned's Return_Possibility asking the same question with two different value sets; see decision_log.

fields.note: Added 2026-08-21. Shows incomingHandoff.reEngagementFields.What_Can_Bring_Client_Back as context next to what-could-bring-back — NOT pre-filled into it (option lists don't map cleanly), just surfaced so the agent sees the prior answer instead of silently duplicating or contradicting it. See decision_log.

computed.showWhatCouldBringBack: ['High','Medium','Low'].includes(returnPossibility) — deliberately excludes 'Unknown', a judgment call not stated by the spec

ChurnedFeedbackForm.submit_logic: apiData spreads in this exact order (order matters for which value wins on key collisions): (1) ...incomingHandoff.reEngagementFields (if any) FIRST — lowest priority; (2) this form's own Maintenance_Offers/Conversation_Type/Call_Outcome/Next_Action_Date/Owner/Churn_Reason — these override any stale handoff values for the same keys; (3) ...branchFields (from THIS form's own churnBranch) — spread LAST specifically to overwrite any stale reason-branch fields left over from the Re-engagement handoff's different reason; (4) Lost_Services/Return_Possibility/What_Could_Bring_Client_Back appended after. Then createTouchpoint(apiData) -> alert -> closeReload. This is the ONLY createTouchpoint call for a handed-off flow — Re-engagement's data and Churned's data merge into one record here.

shared_component.name: ReasonBranchFields
shared_component.purpose: Single definition of the reason-dependent conditional field tree, reused by three forms that each have their own top-level reason dropdown with different values. Each parent maps its own dropdown value onto one of the branch keys below via a local lookup object, mounts this component, and calls getApiFields() at submit time.

competitorName.lifted_because: ReEngagementForm reuses it for its own separate 'Lost To Competitor' outcome section; ChurnedFeedbackForm pre-fills it from a Re-engagement handoff

shared_component.note_field_count: 19 fixed-name fields + 1 dynamically-named field (communicationFieldKey) = 20 total from this component.

used_by: ChurnedFeedbackForm only — no form maps a top-level reason to this branch key in ReEngagementForm; ReEngagementForm's 'Lost To Competitor' is instead its own separate OUTCOME section, not this branch

shared_component.silent_failure_mode: A branch-key typo in any consuming form's lookup object (PRIMARY_CONCERN_TO_BRANCH / REASON_STOPPED_TO_BRANCH / CHURN_REASON_TO_BRANCH) fails silently — the branch simply never activates, no console error. Always cross-check a lookup map's keys against the actual current option-list values, and its VALUES against the exact branch key strings listed under 'branches' above.

business_requirements.source_note: Structured extraction of the BUSINESS LOGIC from the original formal spec document 'TRUCK.ME — ТЗ ДЛЯ ZOHO CRM: Доработка блоков Active Client / Re-engagement / Churned' (Russian, 4 blocks + 2 cross-cutting sections). The document itself is local/Sales - rengagment_churn_active.docx (gitignored, not in this repo) — its full text was recovered from this project's Claude Code conversation history for this extraction. This section is deliberately NOT a translation or copy-paste of the source text — it is reorganized into rules/state-machines/field-groups so the logic itself, not the prose, is machine-usable. Where implementation differs from the literal spec, an implementation_status field says so explicitly; where the spec's rule is simply not built yet, status is 'not_implemented' and it also appears in known_gaps_deliberately_out_of_scope.

block_1_active_client.purpose: Periodically collect feedback from a client who is still active (why they use Truck.me, what they like/dislike, problems, improvement ideas) — but at the Account level, not per Service Case, since a large fleet can generate 10-20+ service cases/day.

feedback_cadence_rule.spec: CRM should track Last_Client_Feedback_Date and Next_Client_Feedback_Date per Account. Recommended (configurable) frequency by fleet size: 1 truck=60 days, 2-20 trucks=60 days, 21-100 trucks=45 days, 101+ trucks=30 days. New Service Cases must NOT reset/change Next_Client_Feedback_Date.
feedback_cadence_rule.implementation_status: not_implemented — ActiveClientFeedbackForm has no cadence tracking at all; it can be opened for the same Account arbitrarily often. See known_gaps_deliberately_out_of_scope.no-active-client-feedback-cadence.

top_level_gate.rule: No -> hide all negative/concern fields entirely. Yes -> reveal Primary Concern, and after picking it, reveal ONLY that reason's own conditional fields.

block_1_active_client.conditional_fields_by_primary_concern: Same shape as ReasonBranchFields.branches (see shared_component) for: Price, Competitor, Location/Coverage, Service Availability, Bad Service Experience, Billing/Payment, Communication, Driver Experience (spec's original label — implemented as 'Driver Related' for cross-form consistency, see spec_vs_implementation_divergences).

improvement_field.rule: Negative feedback by itself must NOT change Funnel Stage. While the client keeps using Truck.me, they remain Active Client regardless of feedback content.
improvement_field.implementation_status: implemented by omission — the widget never writes any funnel-stage field from this form, so the rule holds trivially. What_Can_We_Improve itself is a plain multi-select on the touchpoint.

block_2_dormant_to_reengagement.purpose: Dormant = a client who previously used Truck.me but stopped, per the funnel logic that already exists outside this spec (not modified by it). This block only adds a clear trigger to START working the client back.

rule.spec: When a client becomes Dormant, CRM creates a 'Re-engagement Task'. The client stays Dormant. When a Sales Agent actually starts working the client, they click 'Start Re-engagement' -> stage becomes Dormant -> Re-engagement, and a mandatory Re-engagement Form opens.
rule.implementation_status: not_implemented — there is no Dormant-awareness, no system-created task, and no 'Start Re-engagement' button anywhere. The ONLY way into ReEngagementForm is picking 'Re-engagement' from HomeForm's plain Conversation option dropdown; any client can be re-engaged at any time from the widget's point of view. See known_gaps_deliberately_out_of_scope.no-start-reengagement-trigger.

block_3_reengagement.purpose: The stage where Sales actively tries to win the client back. Needs to capture: why they stopped, the specific reason, what could bring them back, which service to win back, how realistic winning them back is, and how the effort concluded. Ordinary call mechanics (No Answer/Connected/Notes/Next Action) stay on Touchpoints and are NOT duplicated here.

primary_reason_field.field: Why Did Client Stop Using Truck.me? (dropdown, incl. Unknown)
primary_reason_field.rule: Unknown is allowed when the reason isn't known yet. After the call, the agent should update the reason if they learned more.
primary_reason_field.implementation_status: implemented (ReasonStoppedOptions) — the 'should update after learning more' part is a human/process expectation, not something the UI enforces or could enforce (nothing prevents re-opening a touchpoint's reason field in Zoho directly).

bring_back_and_targeting_fields.Target Service (multi-select): implemented (TargetServiceOptions) — spec's option values were a literal service catalog (Oil Change/PM/Tires/Parking/Truck Wash/Towing/Eats/Roadside Assistance/Any Service/Other); implementation deliberately uses ServicesDiscussedOptions + Any Service + Other instead, see spec_vs_implementation_divergences.
bring_back_and_targeting_fields.Return Potential (dropdown): implemented (ReturnPotentialOptions). Spec rule: 'this field alone does not change Funnel Stage' — true by omission, same as block_1's improvement field.

status_field.field: Re-engagement Status (dropdown: New/In Progress/Waiting For Client/Waiting For Truck.me Action/Service Expected/Follow-up Later/Ready To Close)
status_field.purpose: Lets a manager see current Re-engagement state without reading every Touchpoint.
status_field.implementation_status: implemented (ReEngagementStatusOptions) as a plain field with no derived behavior.

outcome_state_machine.gate: Spec: only allowed when there is a genuinely new Service Used record — a promise or 'Interested' response is not sufficient.
outcome_state_machine.stage_transition_spec: Client exits Re-engagement back into the normal working stage per existing funnel logic.
outcome_state_machine.implementation_status: PARTIALLY implemented: What_Brought_Client_Back field exists and is captured (WhatBroughtClientBackOptions). The gate itself ('only with a real Service Used') is NOT enforced anywhere — an agent can select Reactivated freely with no check against actual service records. The stage_transition is NOT implemented — no Zoho stage/funnel field is written by this widget for any outcome except the Churned-bound ones (see block below).

outcome_state_machine.stage_transition_spec: Client stays in Re-engagement; only Re-engagement Status is updated.
outcome_state_machine.implementation_status: implemented in spirit — this outcome writes Re_Engagement_Outcome='Still Working' and lets the touchpoint close normally; no stage field is touched (consistent, since spec says stage doesn't change here either).

Why Not Now implemented (WhyNotNowOptions). Next Review Date deliberately NOT implemented — see spec_vs_implementation_divergences.next-review-date-dropped-for-consistency. Stage_transition NOT implemented either way — no Zoho write moves the client back to Dormant; left to Zoho-side workflow per the project's explicit 'widget does data capture only' decision (see known_gaps_deliberately_out_of_scope.no-funnel-stage-automation) — in practice this is now the 30-day Dormant schedule in docs/ZOHO_AUTOMATION_PLAN.md, not a direct write from this outcome.

outcome_state_machine.gate: Spec: only transitions to Dormant once an established number of contact attempts has been made.
outcome_state_machine.stage_transition_spec: Re-engagement -> Dormant, once the attempt threshold is met. Explicitly: Unable To Reach is NOT a form of Churn.
outcome_state_machine.implementation_status: Contactability='Unreachable' is set unconditionally whenever this outcome is picked (Contactability: resolvedOutcome === 'Unable To Reach' ? 'Unreachable' : ''). The attempt-count THRESHOLD is not implemented — there's no counting of contact attempts anywhere in this widget. The stage_transition is not implemented, same reason as 'Not Now'.

implemented — this is the one outcome-driven transition the widget actually performs, via the in-widget handoff mechanism (see shared_component / the Re-engagement→Churned handoff in DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md), not a literal Zoho stage-field write. See decision_log.
implemented via the same handoff mechanism as Lost To Competitor.

implemented via the same handoff mechanism, pre-selecting Churned reason 'Business Closed' — a judgment call beyond the literal spec (which just says 'open the Churn Form'), see decision_log and block_4 churn_reason_field mapping note.

block_4_churned.purpose: Only for clients there is real basis to consider lost — NOT just because they've been inactive a while (that's what Dormant is for). Needs to capture why they left, what exactly was lost, whether a return is plausible, and what could plausibly bring them back. Explicitly: no separate 'Win-back' process is created.

churn_reason_field.implementation_status: implemented as ChurnReasonOptions with 3 deliberate renames for cross-form taxonomy consistency: 'No Need'->'No Current Need', 'Driver Preference'->'Driver Related', 'Management Decision'->'Company / Management' — see spec_vs_implementation_divergences.

reuse_instruction.spec: After picking a reason, use the SAME conditional fields already built for Re-engagement — do not create duplicate fields/dictionaries. Example given: Price -> What Is The Price Issue?; Lost To Competitor -> Competitor Name + Why Competitor Won?; Bad Service Experience -> What Went Wrong? + Related Service + Shop Name + Issue Severity; Location/Coverage -> Needed State + Needed City + Suggested Shop.
reuse_instruction.implementation_status: implemented exactly as specified — this is the literal mandate behind extracting shared_component.ReasonBranchFields.vue and mounting it from both ReEngagementForm and ChurnedFeedbackForm (and later also ActiveClientFeedbackForm, extending the same principle one step further than the spec explicitly asked for).

lost_services_field.implementation_status: implemented as LostServicesOptions — spec's literal option values were the same truck-service-catalog list as block_3's Target Service; implementation deliberately uses ServicesDiscussedOptions + All Services + Other instead, see spec_vs_implementation_divergences.

return_possibility_field.purpose: Analytical only — understand how definitively lost the client is. Does not trigger a separate process.

what_could_bring_back_field.rule: Shown (and per validation_rules, mandatory) when Return Possibility is High/Medium/Low. Explicitly NOT shown when Return Possibility = No Chance.
what_could_bring_back_field.spec_silence: The spec never states what should happen when Return Possibility = Unknown.
what_could_bring_back_field.implementation_status: implemented as showWhatCouldBringBack = ['High','Medium','Low'].includes(returnPossibility) — this also excludes Unknown, which is a judgment call filling the spec's silence, not a documented requirement. Consistent with the spec's explicit High/Medium/Low + explicit No Chance cases; Unknown was simply never addressed by the source document.

validation_rules.rule: Cannot move a client to Churned without a Churn Reason.
validation_rules.implementation_status: moot in current architecture — the widget never writes a Zoho stage/funnel field for any transition, Churned included, so there's no 'moving to Churned' Zoho-side action to gate. Churn_Reason IS a required form field (:required="true").

validation_rules.rule: If the selected reason has a Detailed Reason defined, it's mandatory.
validation_rules.implementation_status: implemented — every active ReasonBranchFields branch field is :required="true".

validation_rules.rule: If Return Possibility = High/Medium/Low, What Could Bring Client Back is mandatory.
If Return Possibility = No Chance, no further action is required.
No separate Win-back stage is ever created.
validation_rules.implementation_status: implemented by omission — no such stage/entity exists anywhere in the app.

validation_rules.rule: Client remains Churned until a human manually decides to restart Re-engagement.
validation_rules.implementation_status: implemented by omission — nothing in this widget can move a client OUT of Churned automatically; the only path back into Re-engagement is a human picking it fresh from HomeForm, same as any other conversation type.

general_conditional_fields_rule.principle: Agent should never see every field at once. Interface logic must always be Primary Reason -> Detailed Reason -> additional data, one level revealed at a time.

cross_form_mandate.spec: Use this logic identically across Active Client Feedback, Re-engagement, and Churned. Do not build three different sets of the same reasons.
cross_form_mandate.fulfillment_status: PARTIALLY fulfilled, and this is a known/accepted partial: the DOWNSTREAM conditional-field trees for a given reason ARE fully shared across all three forms (ReasonBranchFields.vue, one implementation, one set of dictionaries). What remains as 3 separate lists is each form's own TOP-LEVEL reason dropdown (PrimaryConcernOptions / ReasonStoppedOptions / ChurnReasonOptions) — judged acceptable rather than a gap, because each stage's reason taxonomy legitimately differs in scope: e.g. 'Business Slowdown'/'Fleet Reduced'/'Unknown' only make sense once a client has actually stopped, so they can't be pruned from Re-engagement/Churned's lists, and 'Other' aside, Active Client's list has no equivalent-but-differently-worded entries left unmerged. See option_lists_index for the actual reconciliation performed (renames + the CompetitorReasonOptions merge).

known_bugs.description: No .finally() around the async chain (createTouchpoint -> getRecord -> Promise.all(updateMaintenanceRequests)). If any call throws, isLoading never resets to false — Submit button stays disabled forever with no user feedback.
Calls ZOHO.CRM.API.getRecord right after creating the touchpoint purely to console.log the result. Dead code, safe to remove.
Nothing anywhere checks the per-record status/code Zoho returns from insertRecord/updateRecord. A resolved .then() does not guarantee the record actually saved. Applies globally, not form-specific.

Request table row key is `request.id || JSON.stringify(request)` — that fallback only makes sense if request.id can sometimes be missing. If it ever is, the checkbox's :value="request.id" pushes undefined into selectedRequests, and updateMaintenanceRequests calls updateRecord with id: undefined, failing silently per-record (compounded by no-per-record-status-check above). Either confirm msGetMaintenanceRequests always returns an id, or filter out rows without one before they're selectable.

fetchMaintenanceOffer() (from useMaintenanceOfferStore) is called fire-and-forget with no .catch, same as fetchUser() elsewhere. Functionally harmless — availableConversationTypes already falls back to showing every option when maintenanceOffer hasn't loaded — but an unhandled promise rejection on failure is still console noise worth cleaning up.
Leftover commented-out debug line: . Harmless, safe to delete, same category as Clock.vue.

Every form reads user.value?.id || '' at submit time from a fetchUser() fired at setup with nothing blocking Submit until it resolves. An agent submitting fast enough (or on a slow connection) sends Owner: '' silently — no error, no warning. Applies identically across all six forms.

known_bugs_fixed_this_project.description: ratingOptions used numeric JS values (1-5) even though Shop_Rating/Maintenance_Agent_Rating are Zoho picklist fields, which always send/return string values ("3", not 3). This broke the 2026-08-21 per-row-ratings change specifically for pre-filling: initializing shopRatings/agentRatings from an already-fetched request's existing rating didn't work as intended, since a strict string from the API wouldn't match a numeric option.value. Fixed by changing ratingOptions to string values, and by having fetchRequests() pre-fill from request.Shop_Rating/request.Maintenance_Agent_Rating (String(...)-coerced) instead of always resetting every row to blank.
known_bugs_fixed_this_project.generalized_rule: Match option-list value types to the actual Zoho field type, not to what's convenient in JS — a picklist field's values are always strings over the API, even if they look numeric. A number vs. string mismatch fails silently (no error, just 'nothing pre-selects'), so it's easy to miss until you specifically test pre-filling from existing data rather than only testing fresh user selections.

known_bugs_fixed_this_project.description: Every form assigns multiselect payload fields directly as someRef.value (e.g. Services_Discussed, Client_Likes, Target_Service, What_Can_Bring_Client_Back) — this copies a reference to Vue's reactive Proxy-wrapped array, not a plain array. ZOHO.CRM.API.insertRecord hands data to the parent frame via postMessage internally, and a Proxy can't survive that structured-clone step, throwing '[object Object] could not be cloned' on submit. Surfaced 2026-08-21 via ReEngagementForm (caught by console.log(reEngagementFields) showing Target_Service/What_Can_Bring_Client_Back as Proxy(Array) instead of a plain array), but latent in every form with a multiselect field. Fixed centrally: both createTouchpoint and updateMaintenanceRequests now run their input through JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...)) before calling ZOHO.CRM.API, stripping all reactivity.
known_bugs_fixed_this_project.generalized_rule: Never assign a ref()'s .value directly into an object that crosses the ZOHO.CRM.API boundary without deep-cloning it first — Vue's reactive Proxy wrapping survives the assignment and breaks postMessage's structured-clone step. Fix once at the shared utility choke point (createTouchpoint/updateMaintenanceRequests), not per-form, so new fields/forms can't reintroduce it.

known_bugs_fixed_this_project.description: concernBranch computed originally read only primaryConcern, not hasConcerns. Toggling hasConcerns Yes -> pick a concern -> back to No left the concern's sub-fields rendered and their stale answers flowing into the payload, even though Primary_Concern itself correctly reset. Fixed by gating the whole computed on hasConcerns === 'Yes' first.
known_bugs_fixed_this_project.generalized_rule: Any computed branch/gate driven by an outer yes/no PLUS an inner reason-select must depend on BOTH, not just the reason — otherwise the reason ref's non-self-resetting nature leaks stale sub-fields after backing out of the outer gate.
